final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Symptom: 'Service Availability Disruption.' Caller-side evidence: ts-ui-dashboard nginx log shows repeated 'POST /api/v1/preserveservice/preserve HTTP/1.1" 404 131' (alert: 20 occurrences, entry_service ts-preserve-service) while all other /api/v1/* calls return 200. Object layer is clean: all pods 2/2 Running except ts-ui-dashboard (3 restarts, caused by a transient nginx 'host not found in upstream ts-gateway-service' during rollout, now Ready), namespace events contain no FailedScheduling/FailedCreate/FailedMount/image-pull; ts-preserve-service has no error logs and CheckServiceConnectivity(ts-preserve-service:14568) succeeds from worker-01/02/03, with its Service selector app=ts-preserve-service matching pod labels. The break is in the address layer: the gateway route table (ConfigMap ts-gateway-service-config, mounted into ts-gateway-service) wires route id 'preserve' as 'uri: lb://${FOOD_SERVICE_HOST:ts-food-service}' for 'Path=/api/v1/preserveservice/**' instead of ts-preserve-service, while all 42 other routes match their intended targets. The 'nacos' ConfigMap referenced via envFrom contains only NACOS_ADDRS (no *_HOST overrides), so the URI falls back to the literal ts-food-service, which has no /api/v1/preserveservice/preserve endpoint and answers the 131-byte Spring 404 seen at the caller. Requests to the preserve API are therefore misrouted to the wrong backend even though ts-preserve-service itself is healthy.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-preserve-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-preserve-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-preserve-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-preserve-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-preserve-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        - configMapRef:
            name: rabbitmq
        ports:
        - containerPort: 14568
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 14568
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-preserve-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 14568
  selector:
    app: ts-preserve-service

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-gateway-service-config
data:
  application.yml: |-
    # HTTP Server
    server:
      port: 18888  # HTTP (Tomcat) port

    spring:
      main:
        web-application-type: reactive
      application:
        name: ts-gateway-service
      cloud:
        nacos:
          discovery:
            server-addr: ${NACOS_ADDRS:127.0.0.1:8848}
        gateway:
          routes:
            - id: admin-basic-info
              uri: lb://${ADMIN_BASIC_INFO_SERVICE_HOST:ts-admin-basic-info-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/adminbasicservice/**

            - id: admin-order
              uri: lb://${ADMIN_ORDER_SERVICE_HOST:ts-admin-order-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/adminorderservice/**

            - id: admin-route
              uri: lb://${ADMIN_ROUTE_SERVICE_HOST:ts-admin-route-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/adminrouteservice/**

            - id: admin-travel
              uri: lb://${ADMIN_TRAVEL_SERVICE_HOST:ts-admin-travel-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/admintravelservice/**

            - id: admin-user
              uri: lb://${ADMIN_USER_SERVICE_HOST:ts-admin-user-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/adminuserservice/users/**

            - id: assurance
              uri: lb://${ASSURANCE_SERVICE_HOST:ts-assurance-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/assuranceservice/**

            - id: auth
              uri: lb://${AUTH_SERVICE_HOST:ts-auth-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/auth/**

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-gateway-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-gateway-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-gateway-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-gateway-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-gateway-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        volumeMounts:
        - name: ts-gateway-service-config
          mountPath: /config/application.yml
          subPath: application.yml
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18888
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18888
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
      volumes:
      - name: ts-gateway-service-config
        configMap:
          name: ts-gateway-service-config
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-gateway-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 18888
    nodePort: 30467
  selector:
    app: ts-gateway-service
  type: NodePort
